subject: general
question: Amit's birthday on 16th April 2020 was on Thursday. On which day was his wife's birthday on 2ⁿd June 2020?
solution:
Amit's birthday on 16th April 2020 was on Thursday. 

Number of odd days from 17th April 2020 to 2nd June 2020 = 14 + 3 + 2 = 19

 
• This implies that 16th April 2020 + 19 odd days = 2nd June 2020

(Note: A month with 31 days has 3 odd days and a month with 30 days has 2 odd days. May has 31 days so it has 3 odd days)

19 when divided by 7, leaves 5 as remainder.

 
• Thursday + 5 odd days = Tuesday

So, it was Tuesday on 2nd June 2020.

Hence, ‘**Tuesday**’ is the correct answer.
